bestiary.locations: Gnome Deep Hub in the Gnomish area.

entries.text: Free at last! Free to take revenge on our captor!
We will make the despoiler of souls suffer!
We will have our revenge on the despoiler!
Think I saw a nice gem back there, I need to...
Look into my eyes! No, the other ones!
The mirrors can't contain the night!
I will end your torment. Do not run, little mortal.
*SNIFF* *SNIFF* BLOOD! I CAN SMELL YOU, MORTAL!!
Stop freeing the souls! They are mine alone!
The souls shall not escape me!
